title: Answer assessment items one at a time until completion
description: A student can read each item, select one answer, submit it, advance through the adaptive assessment, and complete it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start onboarding
Fill in the class field with a valid class
Fill in the name field with a valid student name
Fill in the school field with a valid school name
Select STEM Benchmark
Proceed to assessment
Select one answer option
Submit the answer
Verify the next assessment item is displayed
Verify assessment completion is displayed

title: Prevent starting onboarding with missing profile details
description: A student cannot proceed from profile setup until the required class, name, and school information is provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start onboarding
Leave the required profile fields empty
Attempt to continue from profile setup
Verify validation errors are displayed
Verify the assessment flow is not displayed

title: Switch tracks before starting an assessment
description: A student can change the selected track in the hub before launching assessment and the chosen track is reflected in the next step.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start onboarding
Click Continue without an account
Fill in the name field with Test Student
Fill in the school field with Demo School
Submit onboarding details to open the track selection hub
Select STEM Benchmark
Click Switch Track to return to track selection
Select English Literacy
Proceed to assessment
Verify the assessment flow is displayed
Verify the English Literacy track is active
